transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you all for being here today. As you know, we have a ninth-grade student scheduled to return to school on October 16 after an extended medical absence, and I need to sign their re-entry plan before they can come back. Before I review and sign the plan, I'd like to go around and hear current updates from each of you. Could we start with the teacher — how is the student's academic standing, and what recovery steps are you recommending? Then I'd like to hear from our nurse on health-office procedures, our attendance coordinator on the student's attendance records, and our family liaison on communication with the family. Please go ahead.
